fact: By 30 June 2025, 444 of 492 woredas used the PSNP management information system for programme tracking, 5.1 million of 7.9 million beneficiary records were synced in the federal MIS, and 252 woredas paid electronically with bank accounts opened for 1.3 million beneficiary households.
